_comment: usg-radius as an EAP-TLS home server whose static CRL (certs/ca-wrongkey.crl) names the test CA as issuer and revokes nothing, but is signed by a different key. The CRL signature must be verified against the CA (RFC 5280 6.3.3), so the forged CRL is unusable and, fail-closed, even the valid supplicant certificate is rejected.
